goals.title: Define a long-term risk career direction
goals.target: Select a main and backup risk specialization

goals.title: Secure a stable permanent full-time role
goals.must: Keep an active contingency plan if PFT is not secured
goals.target: Secure a suitable PFT role by June 30
goals.stretch: Have two competitive PFT opportunities to choose from

quarterly.Q1: Verify employment path / activate Plan B

goals.title: Reach Senior Analyst level and CAD 100k–110k base
goals.target: Senior Analyst or equivalent and CAD 100k–110k base salary

quarterly.Q4: Assess title and base salary separately

goals.title: Own important risk work and show business impact
goals.target: Own at least two important workstreams and quantify one impact

goals.title: Develop advanced risk analytics and methodology capabilities
goals.must: Maintain SQL / Python and business risk fundamentals
goals.stretch: Use advanced methods in work or produce significant research

goals.title: Build observable manager-level leadership skills
goals.target: Lead a cross-functional project or workstream
goals.stretch: Take formal lead / acting management responsibilities

goals.title: Build a durable professional network
goals.target: 36–48 meaningful professional conversations and 2–3 long-term contacts

quarterly.Q1: Connect with internal leaders and alumni

goals.must: Maintain LinkedIn and existing risk resumes
